newsitem.title: UK: Burford plans hotel joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Burford plans hotel joint venture.

text.p: UK property developer Burford Holdings Plc said on Thursday that it was planning to set up a hotels joint venture company with an unnamed operator as part of its expansion plans.
Nigel Wray, Burford's chairman, said the group was in negotiations with a "proven operator" and in due course the new division could be a successful demerger.

"In the event of a demerger we would probably demerge 100 percent to shareholders with Burford not retaining a stake...," Wray said while announcing a rise in its 1996 pretax profits to 15.05 million pounds.
Burford earlier announced a net asset value rise to 110.1 pence per share from 101.5 pence and offered a final dividend of 1.15 pence per share to its shareholders.
The company's total dividend for the year to shareholders stood at 2.1 pence per share.
The earnings per share of Burford showed 3.30 pence compared against 2.77 in the previous year.
